Boundary 2 (f451): mirror image, flat 248.90 then a 12-step linear descent to 38.67. No black trough. Neither boundary appears in the top-8 luma-jump list any more - they are now indistinguishable from ordinary in-scene motion.
crossfades.implementation: Replaced SceneDipOverlay (black overlay, DIP_RADIUS 9, max opacity 0.62) with CrossfadeScene. Scenes are stacked so the OUTGOING scene stays at opacity 1 and only the INCOMING scene fades 0 -> 1 over XF_FRAMES = 12 (0.40s). Fading only the top layer avoids the mid-dissolve darkening you get from fading both layers at once. Non-final scenes are held XF_FRAMES past their solo end; scene starts stay at 0 / 221 / 451 and the last scene still ends at exactly 670.
